The Newton-Raphson method is a stationary iterative method that approximates a nonlinear system of equations into a linear system to determine an iterative solution. The Newton-Raphson method solves the system of equations for new sets of solutions until a convergence criteria is attained (i.e.,F(P)⇒0). This method involves an iterative pro- cess in which the dependent variable being solved for is updated until convergence.
